derivation: Post-hoc excluded failure diagnostic. Every signed action, action hash, permit ID, decision, cursor, observation hash, state summary and native outcome is copied unchanged from the independently verified formal-v3 replay. The 29 signed retained pose/contact frames were checked field-for-field against the audited replay. Only the 252 source frames with absent qpos/qvel, empty body poses and null contacts receive same-process audited replay pose/contact fields. These additions are derived visualization data, not additional formal measurements.
